supplied_provenance.scope: Research data acquisition and static provenance inspection only; no solver execution, timing, profiling or numerical algorithm changes.
attribution: Timothy A. Davis and Yifan Hu (2011), The University of Florida Sparse Matrix Collection, ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 38(1), Article 1, DOI 10.1145/2049662.2049663.
Scott P. Kolodziej et al. (2019), The SuiteSparse Matrix Collection Website Interface, JOSS 4(35), 1244, DOI 10.21105/joss.01244.
Preserve each unchanged matrix header for original authors/editors and additional attribution.
supplied_provenance.acquisition_method: Windows curl.exe -L --fail with 10 s connection timeout and 30–40 s transfer limit; official collection Matrix Market link endpoint. Network sandbox DNS failed initially; approved network execution succeeded. tar.exe member paths checked against project provenance root before extracting; existing destinations were not overwritten. Archives and member bytes retained unchanged.
supplied_provenance.static_inspection_method: PowerShell/.NET invariant-culture binary64 parser over coordinate records; count header/observed entries, zeros, duplicates, bounds, finite values, stable-input duplicate sums, canonical nonzeros, present/nonzero finite diagonal, row maxima/reciprocal and nonzero scaling range. No symmetry expansion needed because every acquired A is coordinate real general. Hashes via Get-FileHash SHA256. Archive creation UTC records local acquisition-start timestamps, not an HTTP server publication timestamp.
limitations: Static preflight is not global rank certification or a solver/convergence guarantee.
Independent validation should recheck canonical counts/hashes/loader acceptance before any approved solve.
No HTTP ETag/Last-Modified headers were recorded during acquisition; archive and extracted byte hashes provide the pinned data identity.
Auxiliary RHS files are Matrix Market array real general, preserved for provenance but unsupported by the current coordinate-only matrix loader and not used by the prescribed equal-component RHS.
Conditional larger tier spans 2205, 3312 and 4960 rows; no 10000-row case is claimed acquired or validated.
No transformed or canonical matrix files were written; explicit zeros remain in original files.
